literal_meaning: পেটে কালির আঁচড় (stomach with ink scratch)
figurative_meaning_en: To be literate or knowledgeable in reading and writing
similar_in_english: To have ink in one's veins
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে পেটে কালির আঁচড় আছে বলে সবাই তাকে লিখিত কাজে নিয়োগ করে।
গ্রামের এই ছেলেটির পেটে কালির আঁচড় নেই, তাই সে শুধু মৌখিক কাজ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a scratch of ink in his belly, so everyone employs him for writing tasks.
This village boy has no scratch of ink in his belly, so he only does oral work.
note: Refers to traditional ink-based writing, symbolizing education in pre-modern Bengali society.
